grain_rationale: One source row is one hourly weather observation at one airport, so the grain is transactional. The profile reports row_count 13014 and duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so no exact duplicate rows exist and no roll-up is required. No single column is unique on its own (the largest distinct_count among candidate keys is observed_hour_utc at 4341, well below row_count 13014), so identity is derived from the ordered tuple (airport_code, observed_hour_utc); airport_code has 3 distinct values and 3 x 4341 = 13023 slots, which brackets the 13014 observed rows and confirms the pair resolves a single observation. Because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, the identity tuple has no duplicate rows to absorb.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: IATA code of the reporting airport, a dimension with 3 distinct values (EWR, JFK, LGA) and null_rate 0.0, and part of the observation identity tuple.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp that stamps each observation, with null_rate 0.0, 4341 distinct values, and samples such as 2013-01-01T06:00:00 through 2013-01-01T15:00:00 that land exactly on the hour, which is why the grain is hour.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: Local calendar date of the observation used as a calendar dimension, with 181 distinct values from 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: Local hour-of-day label from 0 to 23 across 24 distinct values; it labels the time of day rather than measuring anything, so it is a dimension.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in degrees Fahrenheit, a comparable numeric measure ranging from 10.94 to 93.92 with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dew point in degrees Fahrenheit, a comparable numeric measure ranging from -9.94 to 73.94 with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percentage, a continuous measure with 2178 distinct values spanning 12.74 to 100.0 and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Wind bearing in degrees, sampled in 10-degree steps from 0 to 360 across 37 distinct values; it labels a compass direction rather than being added across rows, and it is nullable with null_rate 0.016828 where the bearing was not reported.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Sustained wind speed in miles per hour, a measure ranging from 0.0 to 1048.36058; it is nullable with null_rate 0.000154 for two observations missing a reading, and the extreme maximum suggests unvalidated source outliers.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Peak wind gust in miles per hour ranging from 16.11092 to 62.14212; it is nullable with a high null_rate of 0.745505 because gusts are only recorded when they occur.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation accumulated in the observation hour in inches, an additive measure from 0.0 to 1.06 with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Barometric pressure in millibars, a comparable measure from 983.8 to 1038.4; it is nullable with null_rate 0.114953 where the station reported no pressure value.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Reported visibility in miles, a comparable measure taking 20 banded distinct values from 0.0 to 10.0 with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: Full airport name describing the reporting station, a dimension with 3 distinct values such as LaGuardia Airport and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: Municipality of the reporting airport, a dimension with 2 distinct values (New York, Newark) and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: Field elevation of the airport in feet, a station attribute with only 3 distinct values (13, 18, 21) that labels the airport rather than measuring the observation.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway length of the airport in feet, a station attribute with only 3 distinct values (7002, 11000, 14511) that labels the airport rather than measuring the observation.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Ingestion capture timestamp with 3 distinct values between 2026-09-02T23:26:11 and 2026-09-02T23:26:13, kept as a load-lineage dimension rather than the event time.

category_description: One row is one hourly weather observation reported by one New York area airport station, identified by the airport and the UTC observation hour, carrying the measured conditions (temperature, dew point, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, visibility) together with the local calendar labels and the descriptive attributes of the reporting airport.
purpose: This mapping declares how the contracted silver table silver.silver_airport_weather enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category: it fixes the event timestamp and its hour grain, the transactional grain and its derived identity over (airport_code, observed_hour_utc), and the role of every mapped column. Its consumer is the deterministic modeling engine, which reads the contract and emits the gold models; downstream analysts consume those models rather than this document.
usage: The proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, checked by the validator and datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval. Once approved, the modeling engine uses it to generate the fact and its conformed dimensions; any change to the time column, the grain, the identity tuple, or a field role must go back through the same contract review.
limitations: The mapping only names and roles existing silver columns; it declares no transformations, filters, unit conversions, or quality rules. It does not exclude or repair questionable readings, such as the wind_speed_mph maximum of 1048.36058 that sits far above the rest of the sampled range, nor does it impute the sparsely populated wind_gust_mph (null_rate 0.745505), pressure_mb (null_rate 0.114953), or wind_dir_degrees (null_rate 0.016828); consumers must handle those nulls and outliers. The hour grain follows the samples, which land on whole hours, so no sub-hourly detail is available, and observed_date_local plus observed_hour_local are carried as source-provided labels without any timezone derivation from observed_hour_utc.
